title: File:Tole Tea Estate sign post.jpg
description: The Tole Tea Estate is a major tea plantation located in the South West Region of Cameroon, specifically in Tole, near Buea. It's situated on an undulating hill at the foot of Mount Cameroon, at an elevation of around 2000-2500 meters above sea level. The plantation was established in 1928 with experimental tea farms introduced by German planters.
